metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: XIGTAL crystallizes in the monoclinic crystal system with space group P 21/n. Reported CIF formula moiety: C92 H133 Gd4 O32 P3,3(C2 H3 N1),0.5(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Gd1 (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd2 (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd3 (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd4 (Gd) has 8 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 2 pairs, 2 components; largest component is a chain with approximately planar metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.856-3.861 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 102.36-106.61°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Gd4(RPO3)2(RPO3H)(tBuCO2)7(tBuCO2H)3(H2O)3]·3CH3CN·0.5H2O (R = 9-methyl-9H-fluoren-9-yl; crystallographic C196H286Gd8N6O65P6). Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 3 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 3 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
